native_rules: WinFail id is16 (0x10), not9; native permanent registration orders Auto7, Fall8, WinFail16. The new runtime binding uses this exact slot/order and releases subscriptions on teardown.

After GameState.SetStateToWin, OnWin queries animation-improvement, calls the appropriate King callback, creates the original ratio array, updates the actual ItemCreator low-match owner, increments lives1 and resets Ego only outside story. King/Life/Ego owners remain explicit required fixture boundaries in these scenes.

LowMatch configuration comes from FTiledLevel.LowMatch through the same runtime path in player/editor. Fewer than3 entries disables and clears state; valid arrays are borrowed, and total uses all entries with int32 overflow. Neighbor count consumes the original difficulty random draw before ratio reads and uses the first2 cumulative cutoffs.

Tuned refill finds the last empty target cell below the filling cell, queries TARGET item mediation, checks down/left/right in that order, preserves duplicate exclusions and calls existing native weighted selection/exclusion fallback. One/two-neighbor rules are distinguished; no current-view or conventional match substitution is used.

RemainingMovesStarted appends missing colors1..4 to match sets using the last existing element weight (default1 only for empty sets), retains existing elements, reinitializes availability/weights and disables every set containing any of special tiled ids10/20/30/40/50. The native owner does not recalculate global set selection totals here.

The win ratio array10,45,45 lives in FoundationSettings as light Inspector data and is cloned per win, matching native fresh allocation. The bytes are verified against actual metadata initializer0xa41138.

Remaining conversion selects its new special type after current-item mediation clearing and virtual ReplaceItem(true). This resolves the callback/random-order gap explicitly recorded in the previous checkpoint.

Goal UI verification waits when the model is complete while the final UI flight/check is pending. Actual WinFail now blocks player input immediately on model victory; it does not permit test-driven extra moves during that interval.
